From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API usage profile & peak TPS confirmation

Hi Samira — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put numbers together: 

Summary from our discovery call:
- Primary use: in-product assistance + support summarization for enterprise customers.
- Expected steady-state monthly tokens: you mentioned a baseline of ~8M tokens/month, with growth to ~20–30M/mo within 6–9 months depending on rollout cadence.
- Spike events: several planned marketing & product events (one big Q4 campaign) that could push short-duration peak TPS well above baseline. You estimated single-day peaks today of ~200–300 TPS for brief windows.
- Current target for hosted spend: rough budget target of $15–$20 per 1M tokens (we heard $15 target for committed pricing).

As next steps we need two quick clarifications to model pricing and capacity: 
1) Can you confirm a realistic monthly range we should size for (low / expected / high) — e.g., 5M / 15M / 30M tokens?
2) For the spike windows: what is the longest sustained spike you expect (seconds / minutes / hours) and an approximate peak TPS for that sustained period (not instantaneous bursts)?

I attached a one-sheet you can fill out (GaugeAI_traffic_shape.csv) if that makes it easier. Once we have these numbers I’ll put together two commercial options: (A) hosted pay-as-you-go with scaled discounts by slab and (B) a committed slab (monthly) with lower $/1M and recommended concurrency controls.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync early next week to validate the traffic shape and agree a target $/1M to feed pricing. Are you available Monday or Tuesday morning PT?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

Thanks Marcus — quick answers below. Appreciate the tidy recap.

Baseline / forecast:
- Low: 6M tokens/month (pilot scope)
- Expected: ~14–18M tokens/month after expanded rollout (Q3)
- High (Q4 ramp): 28–35M tokens/month (post campaign)

Spike shape details:
- Typical campaign spike: ~5–15 minutes at the absolute peak, then tailing minutes at a lower TPS.
- Sustained elevated period (several hours) could happen for product launches but at ~60–80% of peak.
- Example: expected short peak for campaign day: 240–280 TPS sustained for ~10 minutes; sustained multi-hour uplift at ~80–120 TPS possible during day-of-event.

Budget / unit economics:
- Target commercial: ideally $15/1M with some wiggle room if we commit to a multi-month slab.
- Procurement will want to see a clear slab and the fallback pay-as-you-go rate. Looping them in: procurement@gaugeai.com.

I filled out the attached CSV with hourly shape for a representative week. Let me know if you want the raw event telemetry instead.

Monday morning PT works for a quick follow-up — 9:30am PT preferred.

Cheers,

Thanks for the forward — good detail from Samira. Quick internal take and proposed commercial structure to share in the Monday call: 

Commercial options (hosted):
- Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $22 per 1M tokens (list), with automated slab discounts kicking in at monthly thresholds on our billing engine.
- Committed monthly slabs (prepay/commit):
  - 0–5M: $20/1M
  - 5–25M: $16/1M
  - 25–50M: $12/1M
  - 50M+: custom enterprise pricing (negotiable)

Notes on peak TPS & capacity:
- Short 10–15 minute spikes to 240–280 TPS are feasible on hosted provided we enable autoscaling with multi-zone pooling and set a brief concurrency queueing window (we call this progressive burst). That will add transient infrastructure cost but preserves customer experience.
- For repeated multi-hour elevated periods at ~100–120 TPS, hosted can still handle it, but predictability and cost efficiency improve with a Dedicated pool (we should surface Dedicated as option and show unit economics).
- Recommend we present both cost tradeoffs in the Monday call: "Hosted slab" vs "Dedicated baseline + burst to hosted".

Deliverables before the call:
- Marcus: 1-pager commercial summary with the slab table above and accompanying example invoices at 15M and 30M monthly burn.
- Neha: short ops note on autoscaling knob recommendations and expected latency SLO impact when handling 250TPS bursts in hosted.

I attached a cleaned SOW draft and a pricing worksheet (GaugeAI_MonthlyForecast.xlsx) for the meeting. I can join Monday 9:30am PT.
